title: chrysosplenium lanuginosum var. formosanum
intro: Chrysosplenium lanuginosum var. formosanum, commonly known as Taiwan spleenwort, is a species of flowering plant in the family Saxifragaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various medicinal applications, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and treating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Taiwan spleenwort are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
